comment: Unfair teacher. Makes you memorize tons of random dates and art pieces that you will just forget after the class but will waste tons of time trying to memorize. Furthermore, a pseudo-intellectual who will give unfair advantages to students based on preference. Do not recommend.
Prof. Chen is like one of those hidden gems that you happen to find in life. Must take for history gen ed and he'll probably be the most loved professor for art history majors as well.
I don't even like art history, but its my favorite class so far because he's the one teaching it. Enthusiastic, fun and the chillest teacher I know and most lenient and understanding grader ever.
Must take for fulfilling your history gen-ed. Super nice, chill and caring. Take this class and enjoy life

Dr. Chen is one of the nicest professors I've ever had and he is truly a real caring guy. The class is actually pretty easy too, and readings aren't completely necessary, but help for sure. Attendance isn't checked but he can probably notice if you're gone. Forgiving guy and forgiving grader, he really wants you to learn! Easy gen ed
nice guy, insane amounts of reading about boring topics

Prof Chen is a visiting professor I think, but if he stays and you need to fulfill your history gened, he is a solid choice. Art history is weird, but his personality makes it way more enjoyable. He doesn't check attendance, but participation is extremely important. In all, he is a really nice teacher and the class isn't that hard
